verifier: adversarial verifier, integration lane client, round 1, 2026-10-29. Re-measured at HEAD 793cc729 (= origin) in real Chrome on dev :5190. The engineer reports were not trusted.
summary: Lane client fails round 1 on one major item. lead:new-icons is only partly done, because two of its 18 new item paintings broke the 'no gore' rule in WORLD.md:19 when they were graded. shadowpin now shows a pale spike driven into a glossy dark-red pool, which reads as a blade in blood. lampblack_edge's black soot flecks and smoke curl came out dark red on the blade tip. The raw paintings (tools/imagegen/raw/item_shadowpin*.png, item_lampblack_edge*.png) are violet-black ink and black soot. icon_grade.py keyed those dark, blue-leaning pixels as ground and repainted them in the Strike red ramp. The other 16 icons are clean: no hood, mask or face, and no gear, clock hand or rune. Everything else holds. done:5 passes with the shipped CSS and no injected style: all 48 splashes give card p50 80-89 and plate 87-97 at 1920x1080, and card 73-82 and plate 83-91 at 1280x720, so 0 of 100 are under 70. hud:HUD-2 passes in a live RIFT match: every HUD face site draws icon.png (ally 24/24, kill feed 9/9, banner 4/4, scoreboard 10/10, target 5/5, recap 3/3). The view plate, credits, tip-mode, scroll fade, lock-in call and ready-check reminder were all confirmed live. client-14 and hud:HUD-3 stay honestly partly done: the plazas are still clipped because the world half (a padded minimap.png plus minimapBounds) is not in yet. Checks: typecheck exit 0; content:check OK with 17 copy-lint warnings and no queue_remind line; icon_probe OK (57/57, but 18 items still borrow a painting until the systems stitch lands); sweep_720 fast 0 failures; e2e all passes the 6 UI journeys with 0 console lines. The e2e store journey fails: the three autopilot matches were all lost, leaving 598 Candles against a cheapest skin of 600. Every client commit touches only lane paths, and all of them are on origin.

I looked at every new painting at 200 px and at 38 px (_harness/_shots/integ_client_ver1_icons18_200.png, _38px_x2.png) and found no hood, mask, face, gear, clock hand or rune. Two fail the WORLD.md:19 'never ... gore' rule:
(1) shadowpin.webp shows a pale spike driven into a glossy dark-red liquid pool with specular streaks. Sampled pool colours are rgb(106,40,37) and (121,68,70) (_harness/_shots/integ_client_ver1_shadowpin_pool.png). It reads as a blade in a pool of blood.
(2) lampblack_edge.webp has dark-red flecks on the blade tip, rgb(83,33,32), and a dark-red curl beside the blade (_harness/_shots/integ_client_ver1_edge_tip.png). It reads as blood on a knife.
Both raw variants are violet-black ink and black soot on navy (_harness/_shots/integ_client_ver1_raw_pin_edge.png). icon_grade.py's groundness() keys near-black, blue-leaning pixels as ground and repaints them in the Strike red ramp. Minor watch: resin_maul's head is two faceted hexagonal amber blocks that come close to a cut-gem read; the drip keeps it resin. Also, icon_probe still lists 18 borrowed items: the content repoint is the systems stitch, which is not in yet.
items.fixHint: Re-grade shadowpin and lampblack_edge with tools/imagegen/icon_grade.py so that dark subject pixels are not taken as ground. Either pass an override that protects the pool, soot and smoke (a subject mask from the raw painting's lower-third pool / blade tip), or cap groundness for pixels with L* < 15 inside the subject box. The pool should stay violet-black or ink-black and the soot black on the red Strike ground. If the grade cannot keep it, re-prompt shadowpin through run_xai.py with a non-liquid shadow, for example 'a spike casting a long violet shadow on pale stone', and lampblack_edge with no smoke curl. Re-run node _harness/icon_probe.mjs. Then look at both at 128-256 px: no red liquid, no red on the blade. Hand the unchanged path list to systems as before.

items.evidence: node _harness/e2e.mjs all exits 1 on the store journey alone. buy_skin reports 'no affordable skin offer': the wallet holds 598 Candles and the cheapest skin offer costs 600. The 300 start plus 117 / 92 / 89 earned comes to 598, because the dev autopilot lost RIFT, BRIDGE and FRAY this run (_harness/_reports/integ_client_ver1_e2e_all.json). The earlier full run (_harness/_reports/e2e.json, 18:54Z) won RIFT and BRIDGE and bought a skin with 783. This is not a regression in client code, but the pkg1 claim that the journey works once all three modes have run does not hold.
items.fixHint: _harness/e2e.mjs store journey: do not depend on match outcomes. Either grant the shortfall through the dev handle before buying and record that it did, or pick the cheapest skin offer and, when the wallet cannot cover it, assert the shop's 'not enough Candles' state and buy a cheaper non-skin offer. Keep a check that real grants arrived (the wallet grows by the sum of postgame grants).
